name: XviIop_InitSif
comment: sceSif init checks then RPC init

name: XviIop_SetDma
comment: sif DMA with interrupts suspended; optionally waits

name: XviIop_WaitDma
comment: polls the DMA status until done

name: XviIop_ParseArgs
comment: matches "name=value" module arguments and converts with XviIop_Atoi

name: XviServer_Start
comment: CreateThread + StartThread; prints "Server thread create/start failed" or "Server installed ver"

name: XviServer_Stop
comment: TerminateThread + DeleteThread + unregister; prints "Server thread delete failed"

name: XviServer_Thread
comment: registers the RPC server then runs the sifcmd loop

name: XviServer_Register
comment: sets up the RPC queue and registers the server

name: XviServer_Unregister
comment: removes the server and queue ("Server un registed failed")

name: XviClient_Bind
comment: binds an RPC client by GUID, retrying; creates the client semaphore ("Client module bind failed", "Client Re entrant Semapho create failed")

name: XviClient_Call
comment: RPC call serialised by the client semaphore
